title: setup: a deck with four slides, a collaborator invited through the real invitation flow
A1 + A2 the owner and the collaborator both open Comments; the empty state explains what comments are (and that they stay out of the slides)
B1 + E1 a comment on a slide shows in the owner's panel, the slide's bubble and the toolbar count; the collaborator sees it live with an unread dot
E2 + B3 opening the panel clears the dot; a reply from the collaborator appears for the owner in order, with name and time
B2 "Pin to a spot": click the slide, a numbered pin appears exactly there, stays put when the window is resized, and clicking it opens its thread
B4 + G2 empty and too-long comments are refused with a plain message and the draft is kept; when the API is down the draft is kept and Send works again

title: B5 + B6 HTML, script and emoji show as plain text and nothing runs; Enter adds a line, Cmd/Ctrl+Enter sends
B7 a double click on Comment posts one comment; typing in the box never deletes or undoes the slide
C1 + C2 typing @ lists the owner and the collaborator (names only), arrows + Enter pick one; the mention is highlighted and the person gets ONE email with the excerpt
D1 + D4 the collaborator resolves a thread; the owner sees it under Resolved (and its pin is gone), then reopens it; the filters and "only this slide" work
D2 + D3 only the author sees Edit; the edit shows "edited" to the other person; Delete is offered on own comments (the owner on all); deleting the first comment removes the thread
D5 clicking a thread on another slide jumps to that slide and highlights its pin
D6 deleting the slide a thread is on moves it under "On removed slides"; undo brings it back to the slide
E4 two people post at the same moment: both appear once, for both
E3 the owner goes offline, the collaborator keeps commenting; when the owner is back the comments catch up (live reconnect or the next refresh)

title: F1 Present mode and the view-only link page show no comment text and no pins
F2 + F6 exported files contain no comment text; comments never change the deck's revision or the undo history
F4 Duplicate starts with no comments; the original keeps its own
A4 removing the collaborator ends their access at once (banner, no comments); their earlier comments stay for the owner with their name
G3 300 threads on one deck: the panel opens fast and the slide rail stays responsive
G4 phone width (390 px): the panel is a sheet that fits, the composer and Comment are reachable, and nothing scrolls sideways
G5 every control in the panel has a name and the Tab key reaches the composer, Comment, Reply and Resolve
